assumptions: Each sample is one observation; a subject sampled twice belongs in the adjusting column.
Every sample is clustered on the same channels and transform, so a cluster is the same cells in each.
limits: edgeR's dispersion trend is not fitted (diffcyt's default, trend none); limma-voom and GLMM variants are not offered.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which cell populations change in abundance between two groups of samples?

description: diffcyt differential abundance over project FCS files and a sample sheet: every sample's events (optionally one gated population) clustered together by FlowSOM on asinh-transformed channels, counted per sample, and each cluster's abundance compared between two levels of a sample-sheet column by edgeR (negative binomial GLM, Cox-Reid common and shrunk tagwise dispersions, likelihood-ratio test, Benjamini-Hochberg), optionally adjusting for a second column; with state channels, also each cluster's median of each state channel compared between the levels by limma (diffcyt testDS_limma: medians weighted by event count, empirical Bayes, moderated t, Benjamini-Hochberg).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

channels.description: the channels to cluster on (diffcyt's type markers), comma-separated PnN or PnS; empty for every fluorescence channel.

cluster_cofactor.description: asinh(x / cofactor) before clustering: diffcyt's default 5 is the CyTOF one, 150 common for fluorescence.

cluster_seed.description: R's set.seed before the map is trained (diffcyt seed_clustering).

compared.description: the level compared with the baseline; empty for the first other one.

condition.description: the sample sheet's column whose two levels are compared.

covariate.description: a second sample-sheet column the model adjusts for (donor, batch, time); empty for none.

covariate_as.description: the adjusting column as groups (a factor) or as a number. Values: factor (groups), number (a number).

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

meta_clustering.description: group the map nodes into metaclusters by ConsensusClusterPlus (otherwise every node is a cluster).

meta_k.description: the number of metaclusters. Only applies when meta_clustering is true.

min_cells.description: a cluster is tested when at least min_samples samples hold this many of its events.

min_samples.description: see min_cells; empty for half the samples.

normalize.description: TMM normalization factors on the cluster counts.

population.description: a population of the strategy, gated in every file before clustering; empty for every event.

reference.description: the condition's baseline level; empty for the first in the sheet.

sample_sheet.description: a CSV in the project whose first column, headed sample, names each FCS file.

samples.description: the FCS files to compare, by name or id, comma-separated; empty for every FCS file in the project.

state_channels.description: channels whose per-cluster medians are compared too (diffcyt's state markers, testDS_limma), comma-separated PnN or PnS, none of them clustered on; empty for none.

state_trend.description: testDS_limma's trend: the prior variance follows each row's average median (limma eBayes trend = TRUE).

name: differential_abundance_flow_cytometry

clusters.description: per cluster: logFC, logCPM, LR, p and adjusted p (NaN, with the reason, where the filter left it out)

counts.description: the cluster × sample event counts, the samples and the clustered channels

differential_state.description: when state channels were given: per cluster and state marker, the median difference (asinh scale), average median, moderated t, p and adjusted p, and the prior df

dispersion.description: edgeR's common dispersion, the tested clusters' tagwise dispersions and the prior degrees of freedom
